messages:
elaine: FYI noticed a weird pattern: clients reconnecting to WS streams get a final summary event twice when resume happens inside our 50ms grace window. billing and dashboard show doubled usage for a handful of orgs. anyone seen this?

raj: I traced one case to gateway-proxy: when socket close arrives, proxy emits summary frame then queues a resume replay. Replay logic treats summary like any other chunk and re-sends.

ben: paste of proxy excerpt:
```
[2026-03-20T13:12:02.112Z] ws conn=xyz recv: :summary {"tokens":123}
[2026-03-20T13:12:02.113Z] ws conn=xyz state=closing
[2026-03-20T13:12:02.160Z] resume replay start seq=120
[2026-03-20T13:12:02.161Z] ws conn=xyz send: :summary {"tokens":123}  <-- replayed
```

maria: reproducer (node):
```
const ws = new WebSocket(url);
ws.on('message', m=>console.log('msg', m));
// induce resume by killing connection from proxy then reconnect with resume header
```

elaine: looks like two issues: 1) replay doesn't filter terminal frames, 2) telemetry doesn't mark resumed streams so console can't show who was impacted. we should add a tracing tag.

infra-bot: deploy-canary gateway-proxy v3.1.2 started -> pool-b

raj: quick mitigation: treat frames with prefix `:summary` or `:done` as terminal and do not include them in replay window. patch ready.

ben: agree but need to be careful: some clients expect summary on resume to ensure consistency. maybe only suppress if the client already received terminal (we can track last-seq-acked).

kevin: for billing we must avoid double-counting. propose server-side idempotency by (org_id, stream_id, frame_hash) within 5s window. cheaper and safe.

console-team: can we emit a metric `stream.resume.replayed_terminal=1` when replay sends a terminal? that would let us filter affected orgs and add a console banner.

elaine: good call. also add `stream.resume.session_tag` to spans so we can join traces with billing events.

maria: PR: https://git.redwood/gateway-proxy/compare/fix/replay-terminal-filter - adds terminal filtering and last-acked seq check. Unit tests included.

raj: test plan: 1) unit tests cover terminal vs non-terminal replay, 2) canary deploy to pool-b, 3) run client repro 1000x with jitter to ensure duplicates < 0.5%.

infra-bot: canary deploy v3.1.2 to pool-b completed (id: can-782).

ben: first 10m of canary: duplicates dropped from ~20% -> 0.7%. billing anomaly subsided for affected orgs.

kevin: billing dedupe enabled as feature-flag (billing.dedupe.resume-terminal). monitoring shows zero double-charges after flag on.

console-team: added temporary banner to affected org dashboards: "We're investigating a duplicate final-summary event on stream resumes; fix rolling out." also added panel `replayed_terminal_count` by org.

elaine: follow-ups: - add QA checklist item for resume semantics, - update docs about resume idempotency behavior, - consider exposing resume metrics in public usage UI.

maria: will coordinate promoting to prod after 30m stable. raj will handle rollback plan (disable resume path).

raj: rollback ready. plan B: if something breaks, flip `enable.resume` false on pool-b and traffic will fallback to full reconnect (higher latency but safe).

elaine: thanks everyone. can someone write a short note for eng-all-hands summarizing root cause + mitigation?

ben: I'll draft a two-liner and link the console panel.

console-team: ops-wiki updated with timeline and follow-ups. marking thread resolved once promoted.

elaine: promoting in 5m. will post final status here.

infra-bot: promote v3.1.2 to prod pools scheduled.

elaine: promoted. observed stable metrics for 45m; closing thread. thanks!
